concerns.text: Task T001 bundles multiple distinct activities (download, checksum verification, validation report generation, stratified split, PCA fitting, and CSV export) into a single checklist item. This granularity is too coarse for deterministic execution and hampers clear responsibility assignment. Recommend splitting into separate tasks (e.g., T001a Download & checksum, T001b Validate & exclusion report, T001c Material‑ID stratified split, T001d PCA fitting & feature export).

Task T002 combines baseline NN training and the implementation/training of three UQ methods (Deep Ensemble, MC‑Dropout, Sparse GP) with multiple checkpoint artifacts. This aggregates several independent pipelines, making the task overly broad. Suggest decomposing into distinct tasks: one for baseline NN training, and separate tasks for each UQ method’s training and checkpointing (e.g., T002a Train baseline NN, T002b Train Deep Ensemble, T002c Train MC‑Dropout, T002d Train Sparse GP).
